title: Climate Change and Artificial Intelligence
subtitle: The energy consumption of artificial intelligence is one of the main reasons for climate change
excerpt: Artificial intelligence consumes a lot of energy, leading to increased greenhouse gas emissions and contributing to climate change.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The energy consumption of artificial intelligence is one of the main reasons for climate change. According to a report by the International Energy Agency, the electricity consumption of data centers is responsible for around 180 million tons of indirect carbon dioxide emissions per year.

What is Artificial Intelligence and How Does it Consume Energy

Artificial intelligence is a computer system that learns to identify patterns in data during training. For the training of these AIs, hundreds or even thousands of servers can work continuously for weeks or months. This happens every time a user sends a question or command to the system.

Consequences of Artificial Intelligence Energy Consumption

The intense use of artificial intelligence has significant environmental consequences, such as carbon emissions and water usage. Experts estimate that carbon emissions from data centers and AIs could reach 500 million tons by 2035.

What is Being Done to Reduce Artificial Intelligence Energy Consumption

Companies like Odata are working to reduce the energy consumption of artificial intelligence. Odata is investing in more efficient and sustainable data center projects and is working with governments and other companies to reduce the tax burden and increase legal security for data center companies.

Conclusions

The energy consumption of artificial intelligence is a growing problem that needs to be addressed. It is essential that companies and governments work together to reduce the energy consumption of artificial intelligence and minimize its environmental consequences.
